title: Screenshot production pipeline for localized onboarding and quickstart assets
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a repeatable, brand-consistent screenshot pipeline for onboarding and quickstart docs that produces localized, redacted, and properly cropped assets for Console, docs, and marketing. The pipeline should be scriptable for release automation, integrate with Figma source components, and produce QA-friendly metadata (alt text, locale, variant).
acceptance_criteria: Automated capture job can produce screenshots for three breakpoints (desktop docs, console app, mobile) from a single source definition
All screenshots pass PII redaction via deterministic rules and OCR fallback in >= 99% of cases
Localization-safe outputs: no embedded English-only copy burned into screenshots; text layers are componentized or overlaid per-locale
Images are cropped to product-safe regions with consistent padding and 2:1/16:9 variants for marketing
Outputs include metadata JSON (locale, component path, variant, alt text) and a unique asset tag for tracing to PRs/releases
Design sign-off on visual fidelity and brand tokens is recorded in Figma and a design review is in the ticket thread
implementation_notes: Capture: use Chrome Headless (Puppeteer) with environment-controlled locales and viewport presets
Redaction: run deterministic regex masks for emails, API keys, tokens; then run Tesseract OCR to find any remaining text that matches PII patterns and blur/mask regions
Cropping: define component anchors in Figma (console-topbar, route-window, side-panel) and map anchors to crop presets; fallback to automated content detection when anchors absent
Localization strategy: export screenshots using component placeholders (" + "<TEXT_BLOCK>" + ") and overlay translated strings at post-process time; avoid baking long sentences into UI bitmaps
QA: run a validation step comparing rendered text to source translations using fuzzy match thresholds to detect truncation
Storage & CDN: push approved assets to assets.redwood-inference.com with versioned paths and expire-stale flag controlled by release pipeline
Accessibility: generate descriptive alt text from component metadata and allow manual override in UI docs repo
tasks: Define capture config schema (viewports, anchors, locales) - owner: Design
Prototype Puppeteer + Figma export script and commit to infra repo - owner: Eng
Build redaction module (regex + OCR) and integrate with capture pipeline - owner: Eng
Create Figma components with export tokens and hooks for localization overlays - owner: Design
Create QA harness that flags PII and text truncation for reviewers - owner: QA
Document pipeline steps and naming conventions in Confluence - owner: Design
Run pilot on 10 canonical onboarding screens across EN/FR/DE/JP and review - owner: Design + Eng
Post-release monitoring: add asset telemetry to Console screenshot dashboard - owner: Product
decisions: Use Chrome Headless + Puppeteer for deterministic captures (decision made 2026-02-20)
Use a two-pass redaction approach: rule-based masking first, OCR-based detection second (decision made 2026-02-25)
Keep text overlays for localized copy instead of rasterizing translations into bitmaps to support quick translation fixes (decision made 2026-02-28)
Color for blurred redaction boxes: use Brand Gray 800 at 70% opacity to maintain contrast without exposing masked shape (design decision 2026-02-27)
tradeoffs: Overlaying localized text reduces visual parity with exact runtime rendering but improves maintainability and reduces translation churn
OCR-based redaction increases pipeline time (median +1.5s per image) but catches edge-case PII embedded in images
Anchor-based cropping depends on upstream Figma hygiene; fallback heuristics required for legacy screens
